en: Color postcard showing the Mosque of Jakovali Hassan with its tall stone minaret and domed prayer hall set among surrounding buildings. Four people, including a child in red, stand near the mosque looking at it. The reverse side contains printed multilingual captions identifying the mosque, handwritten Hungarian text, address lines, a Hungarian postage stamp and postal marks.
